title: Use of Mr Lee Kuan Yew's Image on Local Company's Commemorative Packet Drinks
what_it_is: Use of Mr Lee Kuan Yew's Image on Local Company's Commemorative Packet Drinks

sections.label: Lee image on drinks packet
sections.summary: MCCY assessed the use of Mr Lee's image on commemorative drinks packets as respectful, and Yeo's clarified the drinks were distributed free, not sold.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: MCCY assessed that the use of Mr Lee's image on the commemorative drinks packet was respectful because the intent was to highlight Mr Lee's contribution to the transformation of Singapore into a green city.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Yeo's also clarified that the commemorative packet drinks were not available for sale, but were being distributed for free.
